cards.explanation: The Spirit leads Jesus into the wilderness "…to be tempted by the devil." (Matthew 4:1) Notice who does the leading, friends. It's the Spirit, not a wrong turn on the map. Some trips start with a plan, and this one did.

The answer is bread. The tempter says, "If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread." (Matthew 4:3) Jesus had fasted forty days and forty nights, so I think a loaf looked pretty good right about then. Friends, I'd have been tempted too.

The answer is False. No stone-to-bread trick happens. The tempter says to do it, and Jesus answers, "Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God." (Matthew 4:4) He's hungry, and He still doesn't do it. He answers with Scripture and leaves the stones as stones.

The devil dares Jesus to throw Himself down. He says, "throw Yourself down." (Matthew 4:6) He's standing Jesus on the pinnacle of the temple when he says it. Friends, up that high I'd be hugging the roof with my whole mustache.

The answer is True. Jesus replies, "It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’…" (Matthew 4:7) The devil said "It is written…" first, and Jesus answers with Scripture too. Jesus points to another line instead of taking the jump.

The devil wants Jesus to fall down and worship him. That's the price tag. He says, "All this I will give You, if You will fall down and worship me." (Matthew 4:9) He's showing off all the kingdoms of the world and their glory. Friends, that's a big offer with a very big catch.

Jesus says to worship the Lord your God, and serve Him only. His words are, "Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only." (Matthew 4:10) Before that He tells the devil, "Away from Me, Satan!" Notice the word "only," friends. It leaves no room for anyone else.

The devil leaves Jesus. The text says, "Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him." (Matthew 4:11) Right after Jesus says, "Away from Me, Satan!" the devil leaves. Then angels come and minister to Jesus. The three tests are done.
